title: PaTaRM: Bridging Pairwise and Pointwise Signals via Preference-Aware Task-Adaptive Reward Modeling
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a reward model for RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) and evaluates its performance on standard benchmarks like RewardBench and RMBench. While the model includes a 'Safety' rubric that addresses unethical prompts and the paper includes a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section, it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, moral reasoning systems, or philosophical ethics as a core component.
